ValidationRule.description: Restrict saving / updating of lead if Amount is null when Referral Category is "Borrow - Mortgage" or "Borrow - Other"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT( CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.IknowToSfIntegrationUserName ) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Referral', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Referral_Category__c,"Borrow - Mortgage"), ISPICKVAL(Referral_Category__c,"Borrow - Other") ), ISBLANK(FinServ__PotentialValue__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please indicate an amount for your Home Loan Referral.
